prompt.alinti: You can turn Claude into a full design team with these 6 free skills. The first adds motion to your components, so your designs aren't stiff or static anymore. The second skill then gives Claude a full design brain, layouts, colours, fonts and charts. And the third audits your code against Vercel's design rules and flags anything weak. The fourth then takes a rough idea and builds a whole design board, including logos, colours and mockups. This fifth skill then pulls the exact colours, fonts, spacing and shadows from any public website, and the last one turns any screenshot or reference into a working website, without losing any of the details. Plus, all these are open source and free. So, if you would like all 6 of the skills, just comment at design and I will send them over.
